cache: warm OS cache, fresh processes, per-case untimed warmup, no eviction
validation: FDB strict source/index open and payload CRC/schema/identity; SQLite read-only without full integrity on open. Both full document/version oracle checks outside query timing.
corpus: same existing first10000, 264842858 text bytes; no generation/reset/repack/copy
limits: No concurrent load, true cold cache or hardware/power isolation. Matrix oracle memory excluded from engine memory claims. Diagnostic spans nest; never sum as exclusive elapsed time.
sqlite: Bundled FTS5 trigram/LIKE; FULL-WAL-built existing DB; cache2MiB, mmap0, tempFILE, prepared statement cache64. Different source-integrity and field/link capabilities.
